_about: Public-domain Isaac da Costa (1798-1860), Dutch poet and Reformed apologist of the Réveil, a convert from Judaism, for the Word Hoard: Israel and the Gentiles (London: Nisbet, 1850) and The Four Witnesses, a harmony of the Gospels (London: Nisbet, 1851), in their English translations, from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 49 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

dacosta-israel-and-gentiles: Israel and the Gentiles, contributions to the history of the Jews from the earliest times to the present day (London: J. Nisbet, 1850)
dacosta-four-witnesses: The four witnesses: being a harmony of the Gospels on a new principle (London, J. Nisbet & co., 1851)

_alternates.dacosta-copies: The 1855 printing of The Four Witnesses

_excluded.dacosta-other: Dutch poems and works (De Perzen, Vijf en twintig jaren, the Bilderdijk volumes, Israël en de volken)
